tickets.title: Coordinate custodian transfer tracking
tickets.text:
Track a custodian transfer through each handoff point, including paperwork status, sending-firm release, receiving-firm receipt, asset reconciliation, and client communication. Use placeholders for account names and transfer identifiers; do not store full account numbers in the template.

Prepare and submit the transfer package for Elena Mossbutton’s taxable brokerage account at Paper Otter Wealth to Velvet Acorn Custody, ensuring all required paperwork is completed, and aim to finalize the transfer by 2025-07-18.

subTasks.title: Prepare and verify transfer package
subTasks.text: Confirm transfer form completeness, registration match, delivery method, and any statement or acceptance paperwork required before submission.

subTasks.title: Submit to receiving custodian and record tracking details
subTasks.text: Send the transfer package through the approved channel and record the submission confirmation, transfer type, and expected status checkpoints using placeholders.

subTasks.title: Monitor external release and resolve exceptions

subTasks.title: Reconcile assets and communicate completion

tickets.title: Complete beneficiary update checklist
tickets.text:
Use this checklist before submitting or recording beneficiary updates:

- Confirm the account registration and account type requiring a beneficiary review.
- Verify current primary and contingent beneficiaries on file.
- Confirm full legal names, relationships, dates of birth if required, and allocation percentages.
- Check that total primary percentages equal 100% and total contingent percentages equal 100% when applicable.
- Identify whether spouse consent, trust documentation, or plan administrator approval is required.
- Confirm whether IRA, retirement plan, transfer-on-death, insurance, or annuity rules apply.
- Send the correct custodian or carrier form through the approved secure process.
- Save confirmation of submission and final acceptance in the client record.
- Note any estate planning follow-up needed with the client’s attorney.

Conduct a consolidated review of Elena and Robin Mossbutton’s beneficiary records across the IRA, taxable transfer-on-death note, and Silver Marmot Insurance life policy, and coordinate with attorney Lara Thimblefern to align with the updated estate plan, completing the review by 2025-08-08.
